title: Anthropic's Solution to AI Danger Is 'Quite Vague': Opinion
description:
Bloomberg Opinion columnist Parmy Olson discusses Anthropic PBC Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei's proposal that AI labs should slow down their most cutting-edge research. "Pacing or slowing down does also just essentially kick the can down the road," Olson says on Bloomberg Television. "Dario's essay was quite vague in terms of how he thinks that should happen."
